# Triviq

Triviq is an independent product and engineering studio building websites, apps, SaaS platforms and digital experiences for businesses worldwide. Based in India, working worldwide.

## Services
- [Web & Platforms](https://triviq.com/services/web-platforms): fast websites, commerce and web platforms (Next.js, React, Node.js)
- [Mobile Apps](https://triviq.com/services/mobile-apps): iOS and Android apps with their back end (Flutter, React Native)
- [SaaS Products](https://triviq.com/services/saas-products): dashboards, subscriptions, APIs and automation (FastAPI, Postgres, Supabase)
- [AI & Automation](https://triviq.com/services/ai-automation): AI features, workflow automation and integrations
- [Business Software](https://triviq.com/services/business-software): internal tools, admin systems and portals (React, Node.js, Prisma)
- [Games & Interactive](https://triviq.com/services/games-interactive): game prototypes and interactive 3D (Godot, Three.js)

## Work
- [Streefi](https://triviq.com/work/streefi): street-food discovery and dine-in offers platform
- [QR Referral & Lead-Attribution Platform](https://triviq.com/work/qr-referral-platform): vendor referral tracking for an energy business
- [Untold](https://triviq.com/work/untold): anonymous mental-health support app, a Triviq product in development
